description: Source code for the ProductDetail React component page, including rendering of product information, images, specifications, reviews, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: renderSpecs
methods.description: Renders the product specifications based on category, presenting relevant details (e.g., CPU, RAM for laptops, etc.).

methods.name: handleAddToCart
methods.description: Handles adding the current product with specified quantity to the shopping cart.

methods.name: handleWishlistToggle
methods.description: Adds or removes the product from the wishlist depending on current state.
